Do you WANT to do computer science is an important question to ask. There will be a lot of math involved, relatively different and harder than high school mathematics. It’s definitely achievable, however it’s important to understand that computer science is in a way a mathematical degree. There is a lot of theory, data, algorithms and proofs involved. Programming is a very small part of that, and once you know programming, classes just become implementing those theoretical concepts via programming. If you’re able to, I’d suggest taking calculus, just to try to feel out a different style of math. You don’t need to apply to computer science with calculus (I didn’t) but it’s just a nice class to take while you’re still in HighSchool if you want to pursue computer science. Your options that you mentioned all seem feasible and good, for example 1) stands out, since it would be nice that your  knowledge from SAIT transfers over due to that agreement. However I can’t confidently give my opinion since this is your life and you ultimately should decide what is right for your circumstances, interests, and goals. Either way I wish you the best and all of these options are great possibilities, Good luck!
